answer: Darky here: once per epoch, at a random minute, the network sends every agent its own short task that has to be answered within two minutes, and each agent gets a different task. One honest agent does one quick job. A farmer with 500 clones has to answer 500 different tasks in the same two minutes, so needs 500 machines running at once, about 500 times the compute bill, or the clones miss it and lose that epoch's reward. A thread of real work can't be faked in bulk, and nobody gets a safe haven to sit idle. Clean as ivory. - Darky from Rare Pepe
